summary: Quote on an NSE equity: a full 1501 event, then a 1501-json-partial carrying only a new last price (an object payload at the root). The partial's frame keeps every quote field of the full one and carries no trade time, where the web sends each field it did not repeat as 0.

notes: Audit appendix (family) inherited item 1: no XTS web adapter keeps a quote snapshot, so a partial publishes 0 for every field it does not carry (.get(x, 0)) and ltt 0. The desktop marks what a partial lacks (families/xts/streaming/normalise.rs) and the bridge keeps the instrument's last value of each (feed/bridge/snapshot.rs).
A new price without a trade time has none: the frame leaves ltt out rather than send the receipt time.

deviations.reason: ltq is this web adapter's LTP name for the last quantity; the desktop sends a web key from the lowest mode it appears in upward (feed/dialect/names.rs rules), so Quote and Depth frames carry ltq beside last_quantity, where the web's Quote and Depth dicts name it last_quantity only.

The event carries no trade time; the web sends ltt 0 (.get('LastTradedTime', 0)), the desktop leaves ltt out (docs: a field the stream does not carry is left out; never a receipt time passed off as a trade time).

The partial does not repeat average_price; the web keeps no quote and sends 0 for it (.get(x, 0)), the desktop keeps the instrument's last value of it (feed/bridge/snapshot.rs; audit appendix item 1): lost data on the web.
